facts.business: Banswara Syntex Limited manufactures and sells textile products including yarn, fabric, and garments, and provides job work services.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure contracted but not recognised as liabilities
Future Export obligation against EPCG licenses
Capital Work in Progress additions during FY 2025-26

key_risks: Inventory valuation and provision for obsolescence of slow and non-moving inventory requires significant judgment and estimates
Dependence on global textile demand and trade dynamics
Fluctuations in raw material prices, particularly cotton
Regulatory changes including Quality Control Orders and GST rationalization
Sustainability and circular economy compliance requirements
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 & 188 of the Act where applicable and details of such transactions have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
